title: Letter to Editor, 22 June 1835
source_note: JS, Letter, Kirtland Township, Geauga Co., OH, to the editor of the Painesville Telegraph, Painesville Township, Geauga Co., OH, 22 June 1835. Featured version published in the Painesville Telegraph, 26 June 1835, p. [3]. The Painesville Telegraph (Painesville, Geauga Co., OH), new series vol. 1, no. 25, 26 June 1835, edited by M. G. Lewis. The microfilm copy of the text used for transcription was filmed by the Microfilm Corporation of Cleveland, OH, 1947, copy at CHL. Each weekly issue comprises two leaves (four pages) with text arranged in seven columns. Exact physical dimensions are unclear as only microfilm versions were available for transcription. Beginning with the 2 January 1835 issue, the paper switched from a six- to a seven-column format. One history indicates that “the paper was enlarged and otherwise improved” at that time, so the change in column format may also indicate a change in physical dimensions.1 In its prior six-column format, the paper measured 21½ × 15¼ inches (55 × 39 cm).
